key_information_units.information: Net sales increased 12.5% to EUR 17.756 million (EUR 15.782 million in 2024); EBITDA was EUR 1.828 million (10.3% margin) versus EUR 1.702 million (10.8%) in 2024; EBIT was EUR 1.620 million (9.1% margin) versus EUR 1.527 million (9.7%); net earnings after tax rose 42% to EUR 862 thousand (EAT margin 4.8% versus 3.8%).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief section, page 4: net sales, EBITDA, EBIT, and net earnings figures and margins.

key_information_units.information: Equity improved to EUR 2.1 million from EUR -2.5 million in 2021, and net cash turned positive at EUR 0.3 million from EUR -5.7 million in 2021.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Information section, page 11: equity and net cash figures for 2021-2025.

key_information_units.information: Ended multi-year "reduce to the MAX" restructuring phase and launched the Vision 2030 Strategic Growth Plan targeting EUR 40 million in revenues (16.8% CAGR), a 14.0% EBITDA margin, and zero net debt by 2030; organic growth accelerated to the 16.8% target by year-end.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Comments, page 6: end of restructuring phase; same page: Vision 2030 targets published in April 2025 and organic growth reaching 16.8% target by year-end.

key_information_units.information: Established Pakistan as the Group's main production base to deliver cost-efficient engineering capacity to European and American projects.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Markets 2025 - PAKISTAN section, page 8: "Pakistan established as the Group’s main production base, delivering cost-efficient engineering capacity to European and American projects."

key_information_units.information: Re-entered the U.S. market through a service contract with MasTec in May 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief, page 4: "Re-entry into the U.S. market through a new service contract with MasTec in May."

key_information_units.information: Announced a partnership with Nokia USA on a 5G EME/MEP testing project in November 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief, page 4: "Partnership with Nokia USA on a 5G EME/MEP testing project announced in November."

key_information_units.information: Conducted trials of AI-powered technology solutions in 2025, with commercialization planned for 2027–2028 and mass deployment from 2029.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Comments, page 6: AI solutions underwent trials and proof-of-concept testing in 2025, with further trials in 2026, commercialization in 2027–2028, and mass deployment from 2029.

key_information_units.information: Currency headwinds in the first half of 2025 – US dollar weakening by 11% and PKR by 14% – reduced Talkpool’s EUR-reported revenues.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Comments, page 6: "Currency headwinds in the first half of 2025 - with the US dollar weakening by 11% and the PKR (Pakistani Rupees) by 14% - reduced Talkpool’s EUR-reported revenues."

key_information_units.information: Independent valuation by BDO assessed Talkpool’s German subsidiary at approximately EUR 20.5 million.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief, page 4 and Management Comments: independent valuation by BDO put the market value of Talkpool’s German subsidiary at approximately EUR 20.5 million.

key_information_units.information: Supported Digicel in restoring Jamaica’s communications infrastructure following Hurricane Melissa in 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Year in Brief, page 4: "Talkpool supported Digicel in restoring Jamaica’s communications infrastructure following Hurricane Melissa."

key_information_units.information: In April 2026, Talkpool signed a Memorandum of Understanding to acquire Netcom Global Partners, expected to contribute approximately EUR 1 million in revenue and a 20% EBITDA margin in its first twelve months.
key_information_units.source_evidence: 2026: The creation of a new star section, pages 8–9: "In April 2026, Talkpool signed a Memorandum of Understanding to acquire Netcom Global Partners... Netcom is expected to contribute approximately EUR 1 million in revenue and a 20% EBITDA margin in its first twelve months."

key_information_units.information: In March 2026, a group of ten investors committed EUR 1.65 million to Talkpool, moving the company to a net cash position of approximately EUR 2 million.
key_information_units.source_evidence: 2026: The creation of a new star section, pages 8–9: "In March 2026, a group of ten investors committed EUR 1.65 million to Talkpool... Following this share issue, the company moves to a net cash position of approximately EUR 2 million."
